data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 were GBP 11.788m. During 2017 the gross provision for claims increased by GBP 1.422m (a 12.1% increase versus opening gross claims outstanding), indicating an adverse/strengthening movement in reserves. The report references an adverse underwriting event affecting the 2016 year of account which is consistent with the observed reserve strengthening.
raw_causal_phrases: Due to an adverse underwriting event the 2016 year of account currently forecasts closing with a loss on capacity of 20%.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure taken from the 'Movement in the provision' (gross claims outstanding) line in the Technical Provisions note. The note shows the total movement in the gross claims provision for the year (1,422.3) which may include current-year movements; an explicit 'movement in prior years' sentence was not found. A gross claims development table (percentages) is present (page 29) but the per-year numeric diagonals required to compute a strict prior-year development sum were not straightforward to extract from the printed rows, so the table was not used to recalculate PYD. Gross premium mix is derived from the operating divisions (divisional summary) percentages printed in the risk section; amounts were calculated from the total gross premium.

_claims_triangle.type_confidence_note: The claims development table is printed as percentages (gross). Numeric per-year cumulative liabilities for the syndicate share are present elsewhere in the table but the previous-diagonal values needed to compute a robust prior-year development sum were not unambiguously extractable from the scanned rows, so percentages were captured as the triangle representation.
